about: CARD RULES for the rulings of 7 October 2026 (Design/DECISIONS.md 5, 10, 12, 13). Written by Bake/content/card_rules.py from the card files, the census (card_census.py), the places files, the spine, weight_793.json and Art/art_slots.json; hand corrections are kept in Bake/content/card_rules_overrides.json. Do not edit this file: edit the overrides and run the script. One row a card. urgency: ordinary (waits 168 running hours, then takes its default) or pressing (holds the ship, takes its default after patience_hours). default: the option taken when the time runs out, with its index in the card's options, its key and its plain label; fallbacks: the other options in the order to try them if the default's check does not hold on the day (if none can be taken, the card goes on waiting). speaker: a person's id (a places file's, the spine's cast.<id>, or wt.<id>) or else the role; speaker_actor is the card's own key for that actor; speaker_name is the person's name, or the name the card's note gives to a person of its own. portrait: the art slot to show; face says whether it is a named person's, a role's stand-in, or none. faces_by_port: for a card that comes at several ports, the person who holds the role at each. speaker_likely: a person who probably is the speaker, not shown until someone confirms it. picture: the card's own slot; picture_stand_in: the slot to fall back to. open: can the card open in the first release (twelve ports, 793 to 805). by: 'hand' where a person read the card and set or confirmed the row, 'rule' where only the rule has spoken (every card shut in the first release is by rule).
